description: Fetch one PORTUGUESE tender announcement by the internal "id" returned from pt_announcement_search. Returns the full record: IMPIC notice id, buyer (with NIF tax number), notice type, contract type(s), procedure model, base amount, CPV codes, lot descriptions, publish date, proposal deadline and window, and a link to the official notice document.

id.description: The announcement's internal id, from pt_announcement_search.
